Argentina topped the group with three wins out of three, and Austria finished as runners-up, gaining the edge over Algeria on goal difference. Both teams thus advanced to the round of 32. Algeria's four points were nonetheless sufficient enough to also qualify for the knockout stage as one of the best third-placed teams.
